Corollary
[Convergence of the convolution series] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0256 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-convolution-estimates 1. ch23:23.21\group Convolution

The series $\sum _{k\ge 1}e^{d(x,y)^2/5t}(\Box _xP_N)^{*k}$ converges absolutely and uniformly on $\mathcal M^2\times (0,T]$; the unweighted series converges uniformly up to $t=0$.
Proof

\sketch Sum the majorant in Lemma 2; it is $Ct^{N-n/2}\exp (C\operatorname {Vol}(\mathcal M)t^{N-n/2+1}/(N-n/2+1))$.

□
